zh: AI 整理收藏时会自动打标签,也可以在上面手动创建。
en: The AI tags items automatically when organizing them; you can also create tags manually above.

zh: AI 整理新收藏时会优先复用这里的标签。
en: The AI prefers reusing these tags when organizing new items.

zh: agent.md 是总则,其余是可分别编辑、可停用的技能;编辑会直接改变发给 AI 的指令,重置可恢复默认。
en: agent.md is the general rules; the rest are skills you can edit or turn off individually. Edits directly change the instructions sent to the AI; reset restores the defaults.

zh: 会自动打上「人脉」标签,记忆列表默认不显示,筛选里选中「人脉」才会看到。
en: This is tagged "Contact" automatically; hidden from the memory list by default, shown only when you filter for "Contact".

zh: 会自动打上「资产」标签,记忆列表默认不显示,筛选里选中「资产」才会看到,并在顶部汇总总额。
en: This is tagged "Asset" automatically; hidden from the memory list by default, shown only when you filter for "Asset", and summed at the top.

zh: 你在对话里说过的长期要求(如「以后开会都留一小时」)会被 AI 自动记在这里,之后每轮对话都会带上。
en: Standing preferences you've mentioned in chat (like "always leave an hour for meetings") are recorded here automatically and included in every future conversation.

zh: 先去「记忆」tab 收藏一些内容。
en: Save something in the Memory tab first.

zh: 先看看 AI 会给出什么内容,不会保存进历史记录。
en: Preview what the AI would produce; this won't be saved to history.

zh: 关掉通知后,结果只在这里和「总览」里显示。
en: With notifications off, results only show here and on the Overview tab.

zh: 写点想收藏的内容,AI 会整理成记忆条目。
en: Write something to save; the AI will organize it into a memory item.

zh: 分类(可选),如 银行卡、房产、保险
en: Category (optional), e.g. bank card, property, insurance

zh: 到设定时间自动执行,结果推送给你。系统会挑合适的时机在后台完成,如果没赶上,到点会先提醒你打开 app,打开后立刻补跑。
en: Runs automatically at the set time and pushes the result to you. The system picks a good moment to run it in the background; if it misses that window, you'll get a reminder to open the app, and it runs right away when you do.

zh: 原文件仅保存在收藏它的设备上。
en: The original file is only stored on the device where it was saved.

zh: 原文已保留,重试只重新进行 AI 整理;未配置 AI 时请先到「设置」里填写。
en: The original content is kept; retry only re-runs AI organizing. If AI isn't configured, set it up in Settings first.

zh: 只有日期、没有时间的事项,当天几点提醒。
en: For date-only tasks with no set time, what time of day to remind you.

zh: 合并更新按任务/记忆逐条对齐,不删除设备上已有的内容;先清空再导入会删除设备上所有任务、记忆和 AI 对话,不可撤销。
en: Merge matches tasks/memories item by item and keeps existing content; Clear then Import deletes all tasks, memories, and AI conversations on this device—this cannot be undone.

zh: 名称,如 招商银行储蓄卡
在设定时间提醒今天开始或到期的事项。
en: Reminds you at a set time about tasks starting or due today.

zh: 它的运行历史也会一起删除。
en: Its run history will be deleted too.

zh: 对话记录会一并删除,不可恢复。
en: The conversation will be deleted too, and cannot be recovered.

zh: 导出一份包含任务、记忆(含附件)、AI 对话与设置的 zip 文件,可用于换设备或本地留档;不含 API Key,与 iCloud 同步互不影响。
en: Exports a zip with your tasks, memories (with attachments), AI conversations, and settings—useful for switching devices or keeping a local archive. Doesn't include API keys, and is independent of iCloud sync.

zh: 已使用内置 DeepSeek API Key,无需再填。
en: Using the built-in DeepSeek API key—no need to fill one in.

zh: 已存在的人脉(按手机号/邮箱匹配)会自动跳过,不会重复导入。
en: Existing contacts (matched by phone/email) are skipped automatically and won't be imported twice.

zh: 开启后,任务会在登录同一 Apple ID 的 iPhone/Mac/Apple Watch 间自动同步;关闭后仅保存在本机。更改后需要退出并重新打开 App 才能生效。
en: When on, tasks sync automatically across iPhone/Mac/Apple Watch signed into the same Apple ID; when off, they're kept only on this device. Quit and reopen the app for changes to take effect.

zh: 影响反问、汇总和洞察的说话风格,不影响解析结果;默认为无个性。
en: Affects the tone of follow-up questions, summaries, and insights—not parsing results. Default is no personality.

zh: 思考强度越高,回答通常越准确但等待更久;只有支持推理的服务商/模型才会真正生效,其余会忽略这个设置,不影响正常使用。
en: Higher thinking levels are usually more accurate but slower to respond. This only takes effect with providers/models that support reasoning; others ignore the setting without any impact.

zh: 总结/复盘类任务打开「带上今天的任务」;天气、行情这类要开「允许联网搜索」;新闻简报打开「带上订阅的新闻」。
en: For summary/review tasks, turn on "Include today's tasks"; for weather, market data, etc., turn on "Allow web search"; for news briefings, turn on "Include Subscribed News".

zh: 所有条目里的这个标签会一起改名。
en: This tag will be renamed everywhere it's used.

zh: 指令原样发给 AI,写清楚要什么内容;每次只会返回一段不超过 120 字的文字。
en: The instruction is sent to the AI as-is—be specific about what you want; each run returns at most 120 characters of text.

zh: 时长为 AI 参考历史类似事项的建议
en: Duration is an AI suggestion based on similar past tasks

zh: 暂无偏好;说一句「以后开会都留一小时」这样的长期要求,AI 会自动记在这里,也可以直接手写。
en: No preferences yet; mention a standing preference like "always leave an hour for meetings" and the AI will record it here, or write one yourself.

zh: 有时长的事项会在开始和结束各提醒一次

zh: 服务商与 API Key、思考强度、联网搜索、AI 个性、语音交互、完成洞察、AI 记忆、Skill 编辑都在这里。
en: Provider & API key, thinking level, web search, AI personality, voice input, completion insight, AI memory, and skill editing all live here.

en: Generates a positive weekly recap in the Done section; no notification is sent.

zh: 稍等间隔、全天事项提醒时间、每日任务汇总都在这里。

en: What you want the AI to do each time, e.g. check today's weather in Shanghai and suggest an outfit

en: Have the AI automatically do something at times you set, like summarizing today's tasks in the morning or suggesting an outfit based on the weather.

zh: 开启后 lodo 会读取步数、睡眠、心率等数据,在本机汇总成趋势;只有汇总统计会发给 AI,原始记录不会离开这台设备。
en: Once enabled, lodo reads steps, sleep, heart rate and more, and summarizes trends on this device. Only aggregate statistics are sent to the AI provider — raw records never leave this device.

zh: 可能是还没授权,或者这段时间没有记录。可以到系统「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 健康」里检查 lodo 的权限。
en: Either access hasn't been granted, or there are no records for this period. Check lodo's permissions in Settings → Privacy & Security → Health.
note: HealthKit 不告诉 app 读权限被拒,两种可能共用一句文案

zh: 配置 AI 服务后,这里会给出针对这几天数据的分析和建议。
en: Set up an AI provider and you'll get analysis and suggestions for these days here.

zh: 还没有健康记录。体检报告、用药、饮食这些跟底下那条「问问 AI」说一句就能记下来,AI 分析时会一并参考。
en: No health records yet. Tell the AI in the bar below about checkups, medication or meals and the analysis will take them into account.

zh: 开启后「健康」页会读取步数、睡眠、心率等数据,在本机汇总成趋势。只有汇总统计(日均、最近一天、环比变化)会发给你选择的 AI 服务商,逐条原始记录不会离开这台设备;关闭后这一页不发任何请求。撤销授权请到系统「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 健康」。
en: When enabled, the Health page reads steps, sleep, heart rate and more, and summarizes trends on this device. Only aggregate statistics (daily averages, the latest day, period-over-period change) are sent to your chosen AI provider — raw records never leave this device. Turn it off and this page makes no requests at all. To revoke access, go to Settings → Privacy & Security → Health.

zh: 返回格式异常:read_trip 缺少 name
en: Invalid response: read_trip is missing name

zh: 返回格式异常:缺少 items
建一次旅行,把航班、住宿、想去的地方都放进去,可以按天看,也可以看花了多少。
en: Create a trip and put your flights, lodging and places into it — view it day by day, or see what it cost.

zh: 去哪儿,如 东京四日
en: Where to? e.g. Four Days in Tokyo

zh: 返程早于出发,改一下才能保存。
en: The return date is before the departure date. Fix it to save.

zh: 这次旅行下面的航班、住宿、地点会一起删掉(它们同时是记忆条目)。
en: Its flights, lodging and places go too — they are memory entries as well.

zh: 右上角「+」手动加一条,或者把订票邮件贴进来让 AI 拆。
en: Add one with “+”, or paste a booking email and let the AI split it up.

zh: 这些行程项的时间不在这次旅行的日期范围里。改一下旅行日期,或者改这一项的时间。
en: These fall outside the trip's date range. Adjust the trip dates, or this item's time.

zh: 填了地点的行程项会自动找坐标画到地图上;这里空着,说明还没填地点,或者按名字没搜到。
en: Trip items with a place are looked up and pinned automatically. Nothing here means no place was filled in, or the name could not be found.

zh: 按「设置 → 资产显示币种」折算,汇率与资产总览共用同一份。
en: Converted using Settings → Asset display currency; same rates as the asset overview.

zh: 给行程项填上金额,这里就会按币种和类型汇总。
en: Add amounts to your itinerary items and they'll be totalled here by currency and type.

zh: 航空公司/航段,如 国航 北京–东京
en: Airline / leg, e.g. Air China Beijing–Tokyo

zh: 住宿名称,如 新宿王子酒店
en: Lodging name, e.g. Shinjuku Prince Hotel

zh: 地点名称,如 浅草寺
点「搜索」选地点才会记下坐标,地图上才画得出这个点;只手打名字也能存,只是不上地图。
en: Pick a place via “Search” to save coordinates for the map; a typed name saves fine but won't be pinned.

zh: 结束时间早于开始时间,改一下才能保存。
en: The end time is before the start time. Fix it to save.

zh: 填了入住和退房,这家住宿会出现在住的每一晚里(退房当天不算)。
en: With check-in and check-out set, this lodging shows on every night you stay (not the checkout day).

zh: 不填时间也能存,会收进「未排期」。
en: You can save without a time — it goes under “Unscheduled”.

zh: 把订票邮件、酒店确认信或行程单贴进来,AI 会拆成航班/住宿/地点。
en: Paste a booking email, hotel confirmation or itinerary — the AI splits it into flights, lodging and places.

zh: 解析出来的每一条都会先让你过一眼,确认后才写进行程。
en: You review everything it finds before any of it is written to the trip.

zh: 取消勾选的不会写进行程。日期或金额不对的,先存下来再到行程里改。
en: Unchecked items aren't added. If a date or amount is off, save it and fix it in the trip.

zh: 没从这段文字里读出行程项。换一段更完整的订单内容试试,或者直接手动添加。
en: Couldn't find any itinerary items in that text. Try a fuller booking text, or add one manually.

zh: 搜索失败,检查一下网络再试。
en: Search failed. Check your connection and try again.

zh: 以下币种暂时换不到汇率,没有计入合计:%@
en: No exchange rate available for these currencies yet, so they're not in the total: %@

zh: 信息来自你导入的订单和截图,更新于 %@。不会自动刷新,请以航司和机场通知为准。
en: From the bookings and screenshots you imported, updated %@. It doesn't refresh on its own — check with the airline and airport.

zh: 导入登机牌或航司 App 的航班动态截图,可以补上航站楼、登机口、座位等信息;之后再导入新截图会更新这一班。
en: Import a boarding pass or a flight status screenshot from the airline app to fill in terminal, gate, seat and more. Importing a newer screenshot later updates this flight.

zh: 更新行程里已有的这班航班
en: Updates this flight already in the trip

zh: 正在识别截图里的文字…
登机牌、航司 App 的航班动态、订单详情页都可以。截图只在本机识别文字,不会上传图片;行程里已有的航班会用新信息更新。
en: Boarding passes, flight status in an airline app, booking pages — all work. Text is read on this device and images are never uploaded; flights already in the trip get updated.

zh: 都是可选的。在行程里点开这班航班,可以导入登机牌或航班动态截图自动补上。
en: All optional. Open this flight in the trip to fill them in from a boarding pass or flight status screenshot.

zh: 没从图片里认出文字。换一张更清楚、正对着菜单拍的照片试试,或者直接贴文字。
en: Couldn't read any text from the photos. Try a sharper photo taken straight on, or paste the text instead.

zh: 没从这份菜单里读出菜品。换一张更完整的照片或文字再试试。
en: Couldn't find any dishes on this menu. Try a fuller photo or text.

zh: 拍一张菜单或导入截图,AI 会整理出每道菜、翻译外文并补上简介,选好了直接给服务员看。
en: Snap a menu or import a screenshot. The AI lists every dish, translates it and adds a short description — then pick what you want and show it to the server.

zh: 菜单照片和整理出来的菜品会一起删掉。
en: The menu photo and its dishes will be deleted too.

zh: 也可以把菜单文字直接贴进来。
en: You can also paste the menu text here.

zh: 菜品多的菜单要整理一会儿,外文会一并翻译好。
en: Long menus take a moment; foreign text is translated along the way.

note: 新建菜单页的确认按钮

zh: 菜单有好几页的,每页拍一张。照片只在本机识别文字,发给 AI 的只有识别出来的文字。
en: For multi-page menus, take one photo per page. Text is recognized on this device — only the text is sent to the AI, never the photo.

zh: 展开已选菜品,给服务员看
en: Opens your selected dishes to show the server

zh: 在菜单里点一下菜品就能选上。
en: Tap a dish on the menu to select it.

zh: 左滑可以把这道菜从清单里去掉。
en: Swipe left to remove a dish from the list.

zh: 有 %lld 道菜没标价,没算进合计。
en: %lld dishes have no price and aren't in the total.

en: The AI assistant keeps one continuous conversation — it is never split into sessions. Clearing it starts over; tasks it already created and anything you saved are untouched.

en: After it comes due, lodo reminds you again every snooze interval until it is done.

zh: 关掉后只提醒一次:事项仍然显示为逾期,你主动点「稍等」也照样有效。

en: Import a shared .md file to load an external skill. External skills are off by default; once enabled, the AI fetches one by name only when needed.

zh: 已有同名的外部 skill,导入会覆盖它的内容(启用状态不变)。
en: An external skill with this name already exists; importing replaces its content (enabled state is kept).

zh: 这是一个外部 skill,导入后默认停用。请先看完下面的内容,确认可信再启用。
en: This is an external skill and will be off after import. Read the content below and only enable it if you trust it.

zh: 描述要写清楚「什么时候该用」——AI 只看到名称和描述,靠它决定要不要加载正文。
en: Say clearly when it should be used — the AI only sees the name and description and uses them to decide whether to load the content.

zh: 确定删除这个 skill 吗?
已经有同名的 skill 了
en: A skill with this name already exists

zh: 以下按「全部能力都可用、没有待办、没有历史」渲染;实际请求里还会随配置增减。
en: Rendered as if every capability is available, with no tasks and no history; a real request varies with your setup.

zh: 最近一次对话加载的外部 skill
en: External Skills Loaded in the Last Turn

zh: 日历访问权限已关闭。到系统「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 日历」里允许 lodo 访问后,这里会显示你的日程。
en: Calendar access is off. Allow lodo in Settings → Privacy & Security → Calendars to see your events here.

zh: 授权后这里会显示你日历里的日程,点开任意一条可以直接修改。lodo 不会替你改任何内容,改动都要你在编辑界面里确认。
en: After you grant access, your calendar events appear here and you can tap any of them to edit. lodo never changes anything on its own—every edit needs your confirmation.

zh: macOS 版暂不支持连接系统日历。
en: Connecting to Calendar isn't supported on macOS yet.

zh: 拖动右侧手柄调整顺序。两张相邻的小卡会并排显示。
en: Drag the handles to reorder. Two adjacent small cards sit side by side.

zh: 点右上角的按钮选择要显示的模块。
en: Tap the button at the top right to choose widgets.

zh: 没有到期未处理的提醒

en: All of today's tasks are done

zh: 连接系统日历后显示今天的日程
en: Connect Calendar to see today's events

en: No trips or birthdays in the next two months

订阅新闻网站或博客的 RSS,文章会按天排在这里。AI 可以总结单篇、生成今日简报,也能在订阅里帮你找文章。
en: Subscribe to RSS feeds from news sites or blogs and articles will be listed here by day. AI can summarize an article, write a daily briefing, and find articles in your subscriptions.

zh: 还没有收藏的文章。左滑文章可以收藏。
en: No starred articles yet. Swipe left on an article to star it.

en: Fetches the original page first; falls back to the excerpt if it can't be loaded.

zh: 还没有订阅。点右上角添加,或者从下面的推荐里挑几个。
en: No subscriptions yet. Tap the button at the top right, or pick some from the suggestions below.

zh: 停用的订阅不再抓取新文章,已经抓到的留着。删除订阅会连同它的文章一起删掉,收藏过的除外。
en: Paused subscriptions stop fetching new articles but keep existing ones. Deleting a subscription also deletes its articles, except starred ones.

zh: 它的文章会一起删掉,收藏过的会留下。
en: Its articles will be deleted too, except starred ones.

zh: 可以直接填 RSS/Atom 订阅地址;订阅博客时填博客首页也行,会自动找到它的订阅地址。
en: Enter an RSS/Atom feed URL. For blogs, the homepage works too — the feed address is found automatically.

zh: 所有小组件都已在总览里
en: All widgets are already in Overview

zh: 在总览里点「编辑」:拖动卡片调整位置,拖右下角的手柄放大或缩小。
en: Tap Edit in Overview: drag a card to move it, and drag the handle at its bottom-right corner to resize.

zh: 点右上角的「编辑」,再点「+」添加小组件。
en: Tap Edit in the top-right corner, then + to add widgets.

en: Couldn't find “%@”. Tap ⓘ to edit it and pick the place with Search.

en: This trip has no city or country yet, so its places can't be located. Add them so the map can pin places accurately.

zh: 没有找到这个地方。这次旅行还没填城市和国家,先回「编辑旅行」填上再搜会准得多。
en: No results. This trip has no city or country yet; add them in Edit Trip first for much better results.

zh: 还没有记下航班、火车或客车。
en: No flights, trains or coaches yet.

zh: 想去但还没定哪天的地点和餐馆会放在这里。
en: Places and restaurants you want to visit but haven't scheduled show up here.

zh: 点行尾的 ⓘ 给它排个时间,就会出现在日程里。
en: Tap ⓘ at the end of a row to give it a time and it will appear in the itinerary.

zh: 机票行程单、签证、保险、攻略截图……放在这里,在记忆里也能搜到。
en: Itineraries, visas, insurance, guide screenshots… keep them here — they're searchable in Memories too.

zh: 和记忆库是同一份:删掉会从记忆里一起删掉,「移出旅行」只是不再挂在这次旅行上。
en: These are the same items as in Memories: deleting removes them there too, while “Remove from Trip” just unlinks them from this trip.

zh: 开启后「日历」页会显示你日历里的日程,点开一条可以查看详情、删除,修改请到「日历」app 里进行。「把任务写进系统日历」会新建一本名为 lodo 的日历,只往这本里写未完成的任务(标题和时间),并且是**双向**的:在日历 app 里改这些事件的时间或标题会回写进任务,把事件删掉会连任务一起删掉(不可撤销)。你自己日历里的日程可以在日历页右键或左滑「转为任务」,认领之后才跟着双向,而且任务删了也不会去删你的日程。关掉开关时会把写进去的事件一并清掉。撤销授权请到「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 日历」。
en: When enabled, the Calendar page shows your calendar events. Open an event to view details or delete it; edit it in the Calendar app. “Write Tasks to System Calendar” creates a calendar named lodo and adds incomplete tasks with their titles and times. Changes sync **both ways**: editing a mirrored event updates its task, and deleting the event also deletes the task (this can't be undone). Right-click or swipe left on your own events in Calendar to turn them into tasks. Once claimed, they sync both ways, but deleting the task won't delete your original event. Turning this off removes mirrored events. Revoke access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Calendars.

这台设备上的聊天记录会被删除,之后要有人重新邀请才能回来。
en: The chat history on this device will be deleted. Someone will need to invite you again to rejoin.

zh: 邀请朋友加入,开始聊天
删 %lld 项 · 加 %lld 项 · 改 %lld 项
开启后,你每发一条消息,这台设备都会把最近的聊天记录发给你配置的 AI 服务商来处理;AI 的回复房间里所有人都能看到。你的任务、记忆、资产、健康数据不会发出去。
en: Each time you send a message, this device sends the recent chat to your AI provider. Everyone in the room can see the AI's reply. Your tasks, memories, assets, and health data are never sent.
A few things to confirm first:

zh: 我的 AI 正在看聊天记录…
en: My AI is reading the chat…

zh: 没有可以改的行程项(航班和带附件的不改)。
en: Nothing to change (flights and items with attachments are left as is).

zh: 还没有配置 AI,去「设置 → AI 设置」里选一个服务商
en: AI isn't set up yet. Choose a provider in Settings → AI.

zh: 这台设备上没有这趟旅行,先加入它的共享再调整。
en: This trip isn't on this device. Join its share first.

zh: 共享的旅行、资产台账和聊天室都会列在这里。
en: Shared trips, your asset ledger, and chat rooms appear here.

zh: 其他成员不能再看到和编辑,他们那边会留一份不再同步的副本;你这边的内容不变。
en: Other members will no longer see or edit it; they keep a copy that no longer syncs. Your content stays the same.

zh: 取不到成员信息(离线或 iCloud 暂时不可用)
en: Can't load members (offline or iCloud unavailable)

zh: 成员都可以查看和编辑。要邀请新成员或移除某位成员,点下面的「邀请或管理成员」。
en: All members can view and edit. To invite someone or remove a member, tap “Invite or Manage Members” below.

zh: 退出后这台设备上保留一份不再同步的副本。
en: After leaving, this device keeps a copy that no longer syncs.
